name: Potion of Climbing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: For 1 hour: a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and Advantage on Athletics checks to climb.
text: Its brown, silver and gray layers sit like strata of rock and never blend, however hard you shake. Once you drink it, for 1 hour your Climb Speed equals your Speed, and you make Strength (Athletics) checks to climb with Advantage.
